title: Miniature World Framework
text: A five-block framework formed by the Ritual of World Formation. Use held items to insert; use an empty hand to retrieve the last stack. Holds nine material types and accepts resonance input above. Restricted portable containers and other frameworks cannot be inserted. Empty recipe containers first.

With an empty initial frame, use an empty hand on a side to display evolution panels. Click inside to cycle starting alternatives, or outside to dismiss. Starting materials determine the evolution route. Later, an empty stack shows the next scene's requirements. Crossing dimensions clears remaining materials.

The first two routes collapse their worlds into a product. Myriad Authorship progressively rewrites one world, ending with a Guide Book, Crystal Pedestal and Mana Engine to form a codex. The final step consumes remaining materials. Taking the product resets the frame. Mining preserves materials and progress.
